_comment: Parity fixture for the Rust reimplementation of the lexical
router's transform. Texts are INVENTED for this test — parity is
arithmetic, not content — and cover accents, digits, casing,
punctuation, a one-character token, an empty string and a long
line. `score` is the probability of the model the app ships,
computed by the exporter's reference implementation.
